segments.en: We also have the question over whether Rebecca Slaughter was able to stay at the FTC and the Trump administration firing her. And again, the Supreme Court here having, I suppose, the opposite

segments.en: decision saying that, indeed, the president is able to do that. This has been something that's been going on for a while with the administration because the president has tried to fire a lot of heads of these independent agencies and the court is finding

segments.zh: 这强化了政府的论点，也符合最高法院一直倡导的“统一行政”理念，即总统是行政部门的首脑，有权解雇任何委员会成员。
